Page positions 2-3 (1-based) = year digits, 1st character = month letter (chart-only, held). Page example F91-90391, normalized to F9190391. Month unblocked by image COMMANDAIRE-2.jpg (see report image-pass list). Distinct shape from style-1 (letter-first vs digit-first), so no shape collision.
